svg.title: Simple network structures
svg.desc: N independent coin flips have no arcs. Traffic model 1 has no arc between rain and traffic; model 2 has rain → traffic.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: No arcs = independence; an arc = direct influence
